text:
Maya: heads-up — a couple models tripped our onboarding microbench due to inconsistent tokenization on newlines. short repro below.

Maya: repro snippet:
```
model: acme-chat-9b
input: "Hello
World"
expected tokens: [Hello, 
, World]
observed tokens: [Hello, World]  # newline collapsed
expected token_count: 42 vs observed: 40
```

Maya: this skews both our golden-input matching and per-token latency numbers. my proposal: add an explicit, versioned "tokenizer-normalize" step in intake that emits a normalized artifact we use for fast admission.

Alex: agree with a normalization layer but caution: normalization can hide ABI/behavior changes. we should produce both raw and normalized artifacts and run benches on each. automated gates can rely on normalized, raw should be run async and used for human triage if it diverges.

Jun: implementation idea: two-stage intake flow. 1) ingest and snapshot raw artifacts (raw tokens, raw tokspec), run a quick raw-smoke bench. 2) apply normalization ruleset (configurable) -> produce normalized artifact and run normalized microbench. store both in model record.

Sara: +1. suggest a small declarative normalizer schema so rules are auditable. example:
```yaml
normalizer_version: "1"
rules:
  - trim_leading_trailing_whitespace
  - collapse_multiple_newlines_to_space
  - unicode_nfkc
  - strip_bom
```

Maya: nice. tradeoffs: extra storage and bench time vs fewer false positives on token count regressions. storage is cheap but intake-on-demand latency matters. can we make normalized bench the quick path (fast admission) and kick off raw bench in background; if raw differs by >X% we open a triage ticket and mark the model for manual review?

Alex: sounds reasonable. recommended gating: automated accept if normalized metrics within thresholds; require raw-run to complete within 24h. If raw token_count delta >3% or latency_p50 delta >7% then create triage. we can iterate thresholds after looking at historical variance.

Jun: plumbing notes:
- intake worker writes two tarballs: model-raw.tgz and model-normalized-v1.tgz
- bencher CLI gets `--artifact {raw,normalized}` and writes metrics prefixed by artifact type
- canonical metrics: `token_count.normalized.v1`, `token_count.raw`, `latency.p50.normalized.v1`, `latency.p50.raw`

bench-bot: queued normalized bench for acme-chat-9b — normalized token_count=42, latency_p50=34ms. raw bench job scheduled id=82472.

Sara: can we also lint for models that register custom tokenizer hooks (pre/post hooks) so we warn that normalization may conceal behavioral changes? lint rule `tokenizer.custom_hooks` -> warn.

Maya: yes. i'll draft a short RFC section for the intake pipeline: intent, schema, gating rules, stored metrics, triage flow, and example configs.

Alex: please include concrete example configs + the gating thresholds. i'll dig historical onboarding runs and propose final numbers (24h).

Maya: action items:
- Maya: RFC + normalizer schema draft (today)
- Jun: bencher support for --artifact selector (ETA 3 days)
- Sara: lint rule PR for tokenizer hooks (ETA 2 days)
- Alex: threshold proposal after historical review (ETA 24h)

Alex: :thumbsup:

bench-bot: raw bench finished for acme-chat-9b — token_count.raw=46 (delta +9.5%), latency_p50.raw=38ms (delta +11.8%). opened triage ticket ML-2987.
